name: MessengerOS for WooCommerce
author: Teodor Mincu

sections.description:
MessengerOS helps you grow your WooCommerce store by turning it into a powerful email and SMS marketing machine.

With the MessengerOS platform and this plugin, you can collect subscribers, send newsletters, automate email flows, and sync your store’s products for easier content creation.

Perfect for store owners, bloggers, and marketers who want to build their audience and increase customer engagement.

Features

  • Collect email addresses through customizable signup forms.
  • Sync products automatically from WooCommerce to your MessengerOS account.
  • Easily select synced products when building newsletters — no manual entry needed.
  • Send email and SMS campaigns directly from MessengerOS.
  • Segment and manage your subscriber list.
  • Personalize your campaigns for better engagement.
  • Seamlessly connect to your MessengerOS account via API.

External Services

This plugin requires a connection to the MessengerOS platform to function correctly. It securely transmits the following data:

  • Subscriber form data (e.g., email, name)
  • API key (for authentication)
  • Project ID and subscriber list ID
  • IP address (for security/tracking)
  • Store product, order, and customer data

These are used for:
– Creating or updating subscribers in MessengerOS
– Sending automated email/SMS campaigns based on customer behavior
– Populating your newsletter builder with WooCommerce products

This integration enables you to streamline your marketing efforts and deliver personalized content to your audience.

MessengerOS Terms of Service: https://messengeros.com/terms-and-conditions/
MessengerOS Privacy Policy: https://messengeros.com/privacy-policy/

License

Support

Need help?
Email us: support@messengeros.com
Visit: https://messengeros.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/messengeros-for-woocommerce or install it directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin via the “Plugins” menu.
  3. Create a MessengerOS account or connect to your existing one.
  4. Start collecting subscribers and sending campaigns.
sections.changelog:
2.1.5

  • Fix: Prevent fatal error on sites where WordPress pluggable functions are not yet loaded when the plugin initialises — decrypt_token() now returns empty safely if wp_salt is unavailable, treating the store as not connected until WordPress finishes bootstrapping.
  • Fix: Plugin initialisation is now wrapped in a try/catch block so any unexpected PHP error during startup degrades gracefully — the site stays up and an admin notice is shown instead of a white screen.

2.1.4

  • Enhancement: Redesigned Data Sync admin page to match the settings page UI — card-based layout with stat counters for products, orders, and customers.
  • Enhancement: Data Sync page now wires up the automatic sync schedule save form correctly.
  • New: Page view tracking — every frontend page visit is now recorded in MessengerOS and associated with a known email when the visitor is a logged-in WooCommerce customer or a past newsletter subscriber.
  • Security: Events API key is now encrypted at rest in the WordPress options table, consistent with all other service credentials.
  • Security: Logged-in customer email is no longer embedded in page HTML — it is set via a first-party HTTP cookie (msngr_email) in the PHP response headers, preventing PII from leaking through full-page caches.
  • Fix: AJAX full sync now clears the cron resume cursor on completion, preventing stale cursor from affecting subsequent cron runs.
  • Fix: Replaced inefficient limit => -1 order/customer count queries on the Data Sync page with paginated count queries.
  • Fix: The msngr_email identity cookie is now correctly refreshed when a different user logs in on the same device, preventing page views from being attributed to the previous user’s email.
  • Removed: Forms admin page removed from the plugin menu — subscription forms are now managed directly from the MessengerOS platform.

2.1.3

  • Fix: Resolved an OAuth token refresh race condition that could cause the connection to break when multiple events fired simultaneously.

2.1.2

  • Fix: Prevent duplicate OAuth token refresh requests when multiple events fire simultaneously, which caused valid refresh tokens to be revoked and the connection to appear broken.

2.1.1

  • Fix: Fix OAuth Connection

2.1.0

  • Fix: Fix OAuth Connection

2.0.5

  • Fix: Fix Subscribe to Newsletter Popup first trigger
  • Enhancement: Read plugin logs from MessengerOS Platform
  • Enhancement: If a visitor subscribes for newsletter in the Popup, use that email for Abandoned Cart automation (if the user is not logged in)

2.0.4

  • Fix: Fix Abandoned Cart automation activation

2.0.3

  • Fix: Restore the shopping cart contents when a customer returns via an abandoned cart email link
  • Fix: Design updates and links updates to the new MessengerOS UI: Horizon

2.0.2

  • Fix: Support for network WooCommerce websites

2.0.1

  • Fix: Fixed popup trigger for Popup Subscriptions

2.0.0

  • New: Major Update – Introduced the MessengerOS Intelligence Dashboard.
  • New: Real-time Analytics Dashboard – Monitor users, active automations, and campaign performance directly within WordPress.
  • New: Abandoned Cart Recovery – Automatically track and recover lost sales with specialized recovery flows.
  • New: Welcome Email Sequence – Engage new subscribers immediately after signup.
  • New: Post-Purchase Automation – Drive repeat sales and loyalty with automated follow-ups after a successful order.
  • New: Seamless Integration – Enhanced data syncing between WooCommerce and the MessengerOS platform.
  • Enhancement: Optimized plugin footprint for faster dashboard loading times.

1.0.2

  • Fix:
    Fixed communications with MessengerOS Platform

1.0.1

  • New:
    Trigger Cart Abandonment Automation
    Trigger Post Purchase Automation

1.0.0

  • Initial release
